verdict.rationale: Forter documents official SDKs you can build against: a Hosted Fields SDK for web, the Forter3DS SDK for iOS (via Swift Package Manager or CocoaPods) and for Android (via Maven), and mobile SDKs that send location updates. The core order, status and evidence integrations appear to be REST APIs rather than SDK-wrapped. Missing for 10: official server-side language SDKs for the core order/decision and Evidence APIs, SDK reference depth such as versioning or changelogs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
